name: bicg
signature: void bicg(long m, long n, const double *A, double *s, double *q, const double *p, const double *r)
layout: A is an n x m matrix stored row-major: element (i, j) is A[i*m + j]. s and p have m elements, q and r have n elements. s and q are output only and their initial contents are undefined. No two arrays overlap. m and n are at least 1.
